resources.string: Medicine Time works like an alarm clock. These settings make sure it rings on time, even when the phone is locked or the app is closed.
Some items still need your attention.
Needed to show reminders. Without this, no reminder can appear.
Lets reminders ring at the exact minute.
Lets the alarm screen open on top when the phone is locked.
Stops the phone from putting the app to sleep.

Xiaomi, Realme, Oppo, Vivo, Samsung and some other phones close apps in the background. Open your phone settings and:
1. Turn on Autostart for Medicine Time.
2. Set battery use to No restrictions.
3. Lock Medicine Time in the recent apps list.
Check that alarms can ring on time
